 Massive LEGO 21375 Godzilla stomps into your collection on Black Friday 2026
 November 4, 2026 
 | 
 2 
 LEGO has officially unveiled its biggest ever buildable creature, 21375 Godzilla , the King of the Monsters, based on the Legendary Monsterverse. 
 Standing at an incredible 70cm (27.5 inches tall) and weighing in at 5,363 pieces, Godzilla is the biggest LEGO creature ever and makes for an awe-inspiring display model. 
 21375 Godzilla will be this year’s Black Friday exclusive, releasing on 27 November 2026, exclusively on LEGO.com or your local LEGO Store. 
 See below for international pricing and product pages:
 21375 Godzilla [US]  – US$449.99
 21375 Godzilla [AU]  – AU$649.99
 21375 Godzilla [UK]  – £349.99
 21375 Godzilla [EU]  – €399.99
 21375 Godzilla [CA]  – CAD$629.99
 21375 Godzilla [SG]  – SGD$579.99
 Fans who purchase 21375 Godzilla at launch will also receive an exclusive 40888 Godzilla Logo & Footprint GWP (gift with purchase) while stocks last. The companion GWP features Godzilla’s footprint, which is perfectly scaled to LEGO Godzilla’s foot, and also includes a brick-built logo, tiny microscale city in ruins, as well as an exclusive Mothra element! 
 If you’re planning on purchasing or pre-ordering this set, please consider using the affiliate links in this post. I may earn a small commission with each purchase that helps support the work I do on the blog! 
 LEGO Godzilla is absolutely massive, and features a head that can be swivelled up or down. It has an atomic breath attachment or a tiny tongue that you can use to re-create Godzilla’s iconic pose firing his atomic breath into the sky.
 The dorsal fins are charged up in the bright blue colour from the Monsterverse movies, and he also has a tail that can be built either to the left or right depending on how you want to display it. 
 Unfortunately, due to the size, and weight of all the bricks, Godzilla is otherwise pretty static. 
 Check out more images supplied by LEGO below.
 21375 Godzilla will be released on 27 November 2026, exclusively from LEGO.com or your local LEGO Store.
 What do you think of LEGO Godzilla? Are you excited to build the King of the Monsters?
